market_view: Calm equity regime (VIX 15.7, 49% below its 252-day high) but the 10-year yield is at a high of 4.81% and oil keeps rising on US-Iran Middle East tension. No family has a stock-specific catalyst in the headlines.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: Zacks 'Oil Surge Continues on Escalating Middle East Crisis' (WTI +13% in 20 days, three-month highs) is a driver move already in the price, and it names no XOM item
oil_gas.reasoning: WTI +8.5% in 5 days is priced in. XOM lagged (-0.2% in 5 days), but a lagging stock is not a named catalyst and there is no XOM-specific headline. Escalation risk cuts both ways.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: the only AEM item (asset sale to Vizsla Copper) is minor and concerns AEM, not NEM
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is -16.5% from its high with the 10-year yield at its high; NEM is +30% in 60 days. No Fed, dollar or NEM headline. The August jobs report has passed and the next scheduled risk is inflation or Fed data.

chips.catalyst: none: the Motley Fool and Zacks items on Broadcom AI revenue and photonics stocks are opinion pieces, not an NVDA event
chips.reasoning: NVDA fell 2% on a day when the sector rose 1.2%. The prior memory-cost margin worry is unresolved, and there is no guidance, export-rule or earnings item. Market-wide AI optimism is not a named catalyst.

pharma.catalyst: none: the Pfizer item is not about LLY; no trial, regulator or pricing headline
pharma.reasoning: LLY is -8.8% in 20 days and the health care ETF fell 2.5% yesterday, but a dip is not a catalyst. No LLY news.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none: the Zacks 'FCX $1000 a decade ago' piece is filler and the Canterra drill result is small and unrelated to FCX
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper hit a 252-day high (+2.2% yesterday) and FCX +5.4% on the day; that is a driver and stock move already priced in. There is no supply-outage or China-data headline, so no continuation reason.

would_change_my_mind: A named XOM, NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX event: guidance change, trial or regulator decision, export-rule change, or a confirmed supply outage or Gulf disruption.

handoff.what_changed: Six days since the last note (09-03). Copper rose to a 252-day high (+2.2% in 1 day), FCX +5.4% and SCCO +4.9% in 1 day. WTI rose a further 8.5% in 5 days on a Middle East/Iran escalation and AMD +5.9% in 1 day, while XOM stayed flat. Gold was flat and LLY fell another 2%. Headlines were again noise with no named catalyst, so all five families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: WTI +13% in 20 days on US-Iran tension is priced in and there is no XOM-specific headline.

gold_miners.why: Gold is 16.5% below its high with the 10-year yield at 4.81% and no NEM, Fed or dollar headline.

chips.why: No NVDA event; memory-cost margin worry is unresolved and sector news is opinion pieces.

pharma.why: LLY is -8.8% in 20 days but there is no trial, regulator or pricing headline.

copper_uranium.why: Copper's high and FCX +5.4% in 1 day are priced in and there is no supply or China-data headline.
